title: Decathlon Run 2026 Review: Runrio's Sporting-Goods Brand Race at SM MOA
seo_title: Decathlon Run 2026 Review | SM MOA Philippines Race
meta_description: Decathlon Run 2026: August 30 at SM Mall of Asia. A Runrio-produced, Decathlon-branded road race at Manila Bay — registration pending.
dek: Set for 30 August 2026 at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, this Runrio-produced, Decathlon-branded race is the French sporting-goods giant's Philippine running event. Registration pending.
verdict: The Decathlon Run brings the French sporting-goods brand's race concept to the Philippines, produced by Runrio — the gold standard in Philippine race production. Held at SM Mall of Asia, Manila Bay's iconic waterfront venue. The Runrio-Decathlon combination means professional race-day operations paired with Decathlon's accessible sporting-goods brand identity. Registration isn't open yet. For runners wanting a brand-backed, professionally-produced race at a proven Manila venue, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: Decathlon + Runrio at SM MOA
paragraphs: Decathlon's global sporting-goods brand pairs with Runrio's gold-standard Philippine race production at SM Mall of Asia. [1] The combination promises professional timing, quality-branded merchandise, and a well-produced race-day experience at a proven Manila Bay venue.
